evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the hint text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the hint text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the hint text
sections.description: Sets the color of the faint hint shown while the field is empty, separate from the color of what the visitor types (default is a light gray, #999999). Keep it dimmer than the typed-text color so people can tell the hint from a real answer, but not so faint it disappears against your background.
